cases.name: Cecelia “CeCe” Barber Finona
cases.about: She was a U.S. Army veteran who served 31 years and member of the Navajo nation. Family and friends describe her as a good-hearted person who cared about people and a leader in the community who made a difference.
cases.narrative: On 2/23/2021, her remains were located in a remote desert culvert outside Las Vegas, NV. He allegedly struck her in the head with an axe and put her in the back seat of her truck while she was still alive. Fiona bled to death in the car as Jay reportedly drove it through New Mexico, Arizona, Nevada, and California.

cases.name: Sasha Marie Krause
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Her parents joined the Mennonite church when she was 11 years old and Sasha soon realized her need for Jesus, her Saviour. She became a Christian and grew in her love for the Lord. In her youth she began writing poems and lyrics for hymns. For six years she taught school at Grandview Gospel Fellowship. One and a half years before her death, she moved to New Mexico and began work at Lamp & Light Publishers. She was instrumental in the literature ministry in Spanish, French, and English."

https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/daily-times/name/sasha-krause-obituary?id=9133705
cases.narrative: On 2/21/2020, a woman camper was gathering firewood near her campsite near Sunset Crater National Monument located north of Flagstaff, AZ. She found her body lying facedown. Her hands were bound with duct tape and she was found not wearing underwear or her traditional head covering, which he had taken. However, the medical and sexual assault examiners did not find evidence of sexual assault. He had dumped her body 250 miles from where he abducted her. Shot in back of head.
